author: Samsung
description:
Samsung Spatial Signage brings a 3D-style showcase effect to retail, luxury stores, museums and other public spaces without the bulk of traditional display boxes. Its slim design and Samsung’s patented 3D Plate technology help products and promotions stand out, even in tight or high-traffic environments.
 
 Managed through Samsung VXT, Spatial Signage works alongside your existing Samsung digital signage. Teams can update and adapt signage-ready content centrally, including visuals created with VXT's AI Studio, so campaigns stay fresh across locations.
 
Discover more at http://smsng.co/yt_B2Bsolutions
